theme: Current affairs — awards & new appointments (who's who now)

questions.question: The 2025 Nobel Peace Prize was won by María Corina Machado, a leader from which country?
questions.funFact: She won for peacefully working for the rights of the people in her country, Venezuela.

questions.question: Who became the new Vice President of India in 2025?
questions.funFact: The Vice President of India is also the leader of the Rajya Sabha, the upper house of Parliament.

questions.question: The Indian song 'Naatu Naatu' from the film RRR won which famous award in 2023?
questions.funFact: 'Naatu Naatu' was the first song from an Indian film to win an Oscar for Best Original Song.

questions.question: The Bharat Ratna is the highest civilian award of India.
questions.funFact: 'Bharat Ratna' means 'Jewel of India' and is given for the very highest service to the nation.

questions.question: India's highest civilian award, given for the greatest service to the nation, is the Bharat ___.
questions.funFact: After the Bharat Ratna, the next highest awards are the Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan and Padma Shri.

questions.question: Who became the new Chief Justice of India in late 2025?
questions.funFact: The Chief Justice of India is the most senior judge and the head of the Supreme Court.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT an award?
questions.funFact: Chandrayaan is an Indian Moon mission, while the other three are all famous prizes.

questions.question: The Oscars are awards given for excellence in films and movies.
questions.funFact: The Oscars are handed out every year in Hollywood, in the United States.

questions.question: The Nobel Peace Prize is given out each year in ___, the capital of Norway.
questions.funFact: The other Nobel Prizes, like those for science, are given in Stockholm, the capital of Sweden.

questions.question: The Indian documentary 'The Elephant Whisperers' won an Oscar in 2023. It was about caring for baby ___.
questions.funFact: The film was set in Tamil Nadu and showed a couple lovingly raising an orphaned baby elephant.

questions.question: A person who wins the Nobel Prize also receives a gold medal.
questions.funFact: Nobel winners receive a gold medal, a special certificate and a large sum of prize money.

questions.question: The Padma awards, like the Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan, are given by which country?
questions.funFact: The Padma awards are announced by the Indian government every year around Republic Day.
